text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
an ordinary day in the life of Duramente."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Early morning run finished.
...Time for breakfast.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaaaawn*...
Now then, what's for breakfast today—

text_block_list.name: Voice on TV
text_block_list.text:
"Time for the Morning Lucky Horoscope~☆
The luckiest zodiac sign today is...?!"

text_block_list.name: Voice on TV
text_block_list.text:
"Aries!!
Something super happy is coming your way ♡"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~!? Unexpected, outlandish, completely unforeseen!
Even Duramente is interested in this kind of thing!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's essential for checking the track condition.
I'll head out for a run right away.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? ...Track condition??

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (0% chance of rain... Morning news shows are so convenient, always keeping the weather forecast on screen.)

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Next up is Question 2!
'Point P moves along the triangle in the diagram at 1 cm/s.
If the area of △ABP after x seconds is y...'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It's "y = 4x".

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: C-Correct! That was amazingly fast.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even have time to think!
How did you move with that kind of speed...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I construct a racetrack with the same conditions in my mind.
Then, I run across it as point P.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I... I see!
So it's about making the problem easier to understand.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
...However, there are still things beyond my comprehension.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If it were me,
I'd aim to shave off 0.05 seconds each lap.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Point P's stamina is astounding, but
one shouldn't settle for a constant speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flump... patter-patter-patter...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The notebook is...
.........

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is indeed the notebook I bought earlier.
Thank you for spotting it and bringing it to me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No.
By the time I found it, they were already gone, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I heard footsteps, so...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even after running up the stairs, she dashes briskly down the hallway.
Thus, she is one of the academy's top record holders for the final 3 furlongs.
Could she be... Flash?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
A simple thank-you gift won't suffice for this, will it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, take a bath and go straight to bed!
Just because tomorrow's Saturday doesn't mean you get to stay up late.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Oh yeah, I'm hanging out tomorrow! Gotta sleep early!
—I can't wait for the movie tomorrow~♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow...
...It's finally tomorrow, huh."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Haha, what's with those sparkly eyes?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ? What is the matter, Hishi Ama-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I just thought she's actually pretty cute, you know? Looking forward to her day off so much and all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~.
No, that was surely—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer.
Today is... finally the day we do that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A new training regimen.
choice_data_list: Yeah! Then first off, warm-up exercises—
Yeah! First, let's do warm-up exercises—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's already completed.
So, we can start whenever you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's get started right away.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's get started right away.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah. As for strength, I've got more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Because I was eagerly waiting for this.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! ...That is true, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Was that too obvious?
